description: Local account screen can only use the four native authentication commands, the two fixed task reads, the four fixed task writes (create, complete, edit details, delete), the nine fixed label and saved-filter commands (list, open, create, edit, delete), the five fixed project commands (list, open, create, rename, delete), the four fixed organization commands (move destinations, create and delete a section, move or nest one task), the three attachment commands (list a task's attachments, upload files to a project, save an attachment), the nine connected-calendar commands (events, accounts, show an account's events, show or hide a calendar, resync, disconnect, open and stop the live change stream, open an event in Google Calendar), the three Google sign-in commands (start, await, cancel), Ramble socket tickets and the Ramble batch save, semantic completion feedback (standard haptics), the account settings read and write, the two read-only search commands (search tasks, Quick Find items), and the two task-link commands (await an accepted task deep link, build a task's shareable https link)
